title: Nasa astronauts' moon mission likely to be delayed due to rocket issue
summary: The mission to the far side of the Moon and back will likely be postponed after problems with were spotted with its rocket, a Nasa official said.

title: At least five people killed in string of avalanches in Austria
summary: Fatalities and injuries reported in avalanches across Tirol after prolonged snowfall and windy conditions At least five people have been killed in a string of avalanches in Austria, authorities said on Saturday. The government office of the Tirol region said intense snowfall over the last week led to accumulations of up to 1.5 meters (5ft). Combined with windy conditions and weak snowpack below, the conditions were especially susceptible to avalanches, it said. Continue reading...

title: Trump Says He Will Increase Global Tariffs to 15% From 10%
summary: President Donald Trump said he will increase the global 10% tariff he announced one day ago to 15% as he lashed out at the US Supreme Court over its ruling that his mechanism for applying tariffs was illegal.
